item.title: 🎉SeonJu recived conference paper award in KSEE
item.description:
SeonJu proudly represented our lab at KSEE, and we are thrilled to share that she received the Conference Paper Award for her work, “A Multi-Objective Superstructure Optimization Framework for Regional Biogasification Facility Design Using Techno-Economic and Environmental Data.”

Her research presents a multi-objective superstructure optimization framework for designing regional biogasification facilities by integrating technical, economic, and environmental data. The proposed approach identifies optimal facility configurations tailored to regional organic waste characteristics while considering both economic feasibility and environmental performance. Congratulations, SeonJu! 🎉🏆

item.title: 🎉Our Lab's Founding team recives encouragement prize in KOSAE
item.description: The founding team delivered the first presentation of our lab in KOSAE, and we are thrilled to share that we received the encouragement prize for our work. Our team developed an innovative forecasting model called M3-PMFormer, which predicts particulate matter (PM2.5 and PM10) across South Korea in both spatial and temporal domains. This AI system effectively captures the complex spatio-temporal dynamics of PM concentrations using a multimodal dataset. Go three idiots!!

item.title: Greenest A.I. Lab to Present Seven Studies at the 2026 KSEE Conference
item.description:
Greenest A.I. Lab will participate in the 2026 Annual Conference of the Korean Society of Environmental Engineers (KSEE), held at Jeju Shinhwa World, Jeju, Republic of Korea, from November 3 to 6, 2026.

A total of seven studies will be presented by members of Greenest A.I. Lab, consisting of six oral presentations and one poster presentation. The presentations cover a wide range of research topics integrating artificial intelligence with environmental and energy systems.

Oral Presentations

Prof. SungKu Heo

  • Process-Informed Neural Operator-Based Optimization of Wastewater Treatment Plant Operation
  • AI-Based Inverse Engineering for Decentralized Wastewater Treatment
  • Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning-Based Data Center Operation Optimization Considering Power and Climate Conditions

SeonJu Kim

  • AI-Based Autonomous Soft Sensor for N₂O Emission Quantification
  • AI-Assisted Mathematical Programming for Integrated Biogasification Facility Design and Supply Chain Optimization

SangGu Yun

  • Multimodal Transformer-Based Nationwide Spatio-Temporal Particulate Matter Forecasting

Poster Presentation

SangGu Yun

  • Development of an LLM-Based Agentic LCA Framework for Autonomous Environmental Assessment

Through these studies, Greenest A.I. Lab presents its recent research on AI-driven wastewater treatment, greenhouse gas monitoring, integrated biogas systems, particulate matter forecasting, data center optimization, and autonomous life cycle assessment.

item.title: 🎉Sanggu and Seungjoon received 2nd presentation award and will visit Kanajawa Japan.
item.description: Our 2025 interns, Sanggu and Seungjoon, received the Second Prize Presentation Award for their research on the multimedia behavior analysis of organic waste-derived volatile organic compounds (VOCs). Their study attracted significant attention for its innovative approach to understanding the environmental fate and transport of VOC emissions generated from co-digestion processes. In recognition of the quality and impact of their work, they were also invited to present their research at an international conference in Kanazawa, Japan. Please join us in congratulating Sanggu and Seungjoon on this outstanding achievement and exciting international opportunity. Go Sanggu and Seungjoon!

item.title: 🎉SeonJu was invited to deliver oral presentations at both IWA WWCE and WIN 2026.
item.description: SeonJu was invited to deliver oral presentations at both the IWA World Water Congress & Exhibition (WWCE) and WIN 2026, two of the most prestigious international conferences in the water sector. Her presentation, titled “Hybrid Transformer-driven Autonomous Soft-sensing System for N2O Emissions in a Full-scale Wastewater Treatment Plant: Sensor Fault Reconstruction, Quantification, and Self-recalibration” highlights advanced AI-driven approaches for reliable greenhouse gas monitoring and autonomous environmental system management. SeonJu will deliver an oral presentation at IWA WIN 2026 in Delft, the Netherlands, one of the leading international conferences in the water sector. Go SeonJu!
